description: OWNER ONLY — submit a structured research finding into News Guru's SharedBrain. kind: idea | anomaly | counterthesis | event. symbols and sources are comma-separated. For kind=counterthesis, thesis_direction = bullish|bearish, the direction of the thesis being attacked, using the composite majority (bullish if bullish_count > bearish_count, bearish if the reverse; omit on a tie). Findings are context for the analyst agents; they never trigger trades directly. Requires an OWNER-tier API key (Bearer / X-API-Key / ?api_key=).
name: submit_finding
